title: Q1 Tower
visualBrief: Complete asymmetric blue/white Q1 apartment tower and mapped podium, projecting rear balconies/courtyard canopy, glazed observation ceiling, open steel/glass sail, northern climb and322.5m mast.

sourceFacts.floors: Mapped78/historical contractor80; no literal facade-count claim
sourceFacts.steelFabricator: Sun Engineering with Orrcon Steel hollow sections

appearance.identity: Curved white/blue apartment shaft, projecting rear balconies, open sloping sail and offset slender mast.
appearance.scope: Complete medium-fi tower/podium bundle retains asymmetric mapped apartment shaft, white floor bands, blue glazing, projecting rear balconies, glazed observation ceiling, open sloping crown sail/ribs, exposed northern climb and322.5m offset mast. Original106501-triangle detailed recipe remains unchanged and reproducible. Orrcon supplies322.5m total/90m crown assembly and curved pipe/RHS construction. Operator describes level77 observation230m, launch240m above street and summit270m above sea level; model uses nominal240/270m geometry and does not claim those published datums are identical. Apartment floors, reconstructed232.5m shaft top, sloping234.5–245m observation ceiling,245–279m sail outline, ribs, mast offset and stair bends are photo-informed approximations, not surveyed elevations. Orrcon historical80-storey wording differs from map78; facade rhythm is reconstructed without a literal floor-count assertion. Owner photographs show pool-side projecting canopy and white/blue facade; canopy geometry/position approximated on rear courtyard sector. Ground entrance locations, hotel rooms, landscaping, separate pool surfaces, surrounding villas and basement omitted. Independent two-storey podium remains modeled. Shared painted metal, concrete and stone graphs with component tint; opaque facade PBR and alpha ceiling/crown glazing; no source photos copied as textures. Tiny balcony balusters and repeated mullions simplify by level. Actual grade, night lights and physical-device timings remain unmeasured.

reconstruction.plan: Actual asymmetric mapped tower floor plate plus independent low podium footprint
reconstruction.crown: Open steel sail and exposed vertical ribs reconstructed from Orrcon Steel construction and completed-building photographs; mast toward the pointed coastal end
reconstruction.roof: Reconstructed glazed sloping observation ceiling keeps exterior climb open; crown itself has no top cap
reconstruction.canopy: Pool-side projecting blade/clear shade canopy based on owner image; exact plan unmeasured
